text: You are an idiot and nobody wants you here.
Shut up, you stupid loser.
I hate you and your ugly dog.
You are worthless, go away.
If you touch my toy again I will hurt you.
Nobody in this town will ever love you.
Get out of my sight, you useless thing.
Only a dumb kid would say that.
You smell bad and everyone laughs at you.
I will kill you if you tell Mom.
Your drawing is ugly and so are you.
Stop crying, you big baby, nobody cares.
Lily and Tom played in the park all day.
The little dog wagged its tail and barked happily.
Mom baked a big cake for the party.
The duckling was ugly at first, but it grew into a swan.
Tim felt stupid after he dropped the eggs, but Mom smiled.
The old car made a dumb noise and then stopped.
Sara said shut up the window, it is cold.
The bird sang a song about the morning sun.
Ben shared his apple with his friend.
The rain stopped and a rainbow came out.
Grandpa told a story about a brave knight.
The cat was sleepy, so it curled up in the sun.
We said thank you and waved goodbye.
The idiom made everyone laugh at dinner.
Anna was idiotically happy about her new shoes.
The loser of the race got a hug and a sticker.
The children built a fort out of pillows.
Max found a shiny stone by the river.
